messages:
maya: quick sync — we need to decide by Friday whether Q2 will use a simplified rate-structure (single unit tiers) or retain multi-dimension entitlements for enterprise deals. this is gating a lot of spec work :hourglass_flowing_sand:
aj: from sales — large customers keep pushing for a committed throughput SKU (monthly vCPU/GPU-equivalent) + predictable overage calc. they don’t want per-token surprises. happy to run 2 pilot deals if we can support a migration path. :handshake:
leo: finance perspective — margin model prefers a clear unit (tokens are noisy). throughput SKU simplifies forecasting. must preserve ability to map existing legacy contracts (prorates, credits). i ran a quick sim: converting 30% of current enterprise volume to throughput SKU improves ASP predictability by ~12%. will share numbers in spreadsheet.
sanam: engineering — enforcement and billing plumbing are the hard parts. per-second/throughput billing needs realtime metering across routing tiers + fallback. per-token remains simplest for runtime accounting. we can implement a translation layer but need to carve out scope and estimate. :gear:
maya: noted — tradeoffs: predictability vs implementation cost & migration friction. can we outline concrete launch criteria?
leo: suggested launch criteria:
- revenue coverage: new plans must cover >=95% of expected committed revenue for first 6 months
- accuracy: billing calc validated end-to-end in staging with <0.1% variance
- migration: CLI/tool exists to convert 2 legacy customer contracts without manual adjustments
- pilot: 2 anchor customers onboarded to new SKU before GA
aj: add commercial constraints: must not block renewals this quarter; migration should be optional for <= $X deals.
sanam: engineering acceptance checklist:
```
- telemetry: throughput counters emitted at ingress and aggregated by route
- enforcement: rate-limiter + quota daemon can accept throughput units
- billing export: parquet with (customer, period, unit, raw_tokens)
- rollout: dark launch + canary 5% traffic
```
maya: timeline ask — if we choose throughput SKU, product spec complete by Wed, eng estimate by Thu, pilots start next week. if we stay token-based, we need a packaging spec for enterprise tiers and clear SLA buckets. :thinking:
aj: quick question — do we keep a hybrid option (throughput for committed, token for burst)? commercial likes that.
leo: hybrid ok but needs clear overage formula; suggest: overage = max(token_cost, throughput_rate * usage_pct). i’ll draft a formula.
sanam: hybrid increases complexity ~1.6x but doable with scope limits (no cross-customer pooling at GA).
maya: action items:
- leo: draft financial model + overage formula (due Thu)
- sanam: rough engineering estimate for throughput SKU + hybrid (due Thu)
- aj: identify 2 candidate pilot customers + migration constraints (due Wed)
- maya: write product spec draft and circulate (due Wed EOD)
ops-bot: created doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/rate-structure-refactor (added to /product/roadmap) :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks — short thread, please ping if anything blocks.
